verdict.rationale: Windmill documents HTTP webhook endpoints, including version-pinned flow endpoints, that trigger scripts and flows programmatically. It also documents scoped user tokens for restricting access to resources and actions, so part of the product can be driven over HTTP. The pack never explicitly describes a full general-purpose REST API for managing the platform, and the OpenAPI probe paths on the marketing domain returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a comprehensive public management API, a discoverable OpenAPI/API reference, and hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Flows additionally expose version-pinned webhook endpoints that target a specific flow version by its numeric version ID instead of the latest deployment.
Use schedules, webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP, Azure Event Grid and more.
Tokens can be scoped to restrict access to specific resources and actions, following the principle of least privilege.
